Naval Staffer Among Two Arrested for Alleged Pakistan Espionage in Andhra

Two individuals, including a naval staffer and a driver, have been arrested in Andhra Pradesh on charges of spying for Pakistan. Authorities allege that the arrested individuals were involved in sending confidential information to Pakistan. The arrests were made by Andhra Pradesh Police.
